entities.name: Gilanra
entities.description: An elf druid of the Wirewood Forest in Otaria who mutated into a green-skinned plant creature and welcomed refugee elves.

entities.name: Wirewood Forest
entities.description: Forest on Otaria where Gilanra lived.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: Source of the influence that mutated Gilanra.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion that left many elves homeless.

events.summary: Gilanra traveled the world telling displaced elves that Wirewood had room, and welcomed each arrival personally.
events.quote: Gilanra made it his mission to personally welcome each and every elf to the forest.
